title: phoxite.json
description: Phoxite's settings for one project, at its root. They are laid over the editor's settings, so everyone working on the project gets them whatever their editor. A project can't set the programs Phoxite runs or the files it reads outside the project: `analyzers` and `laravel.database` stay with the editor's settings, and `includePaths` is read only in a workspace you trust.

phpVersion.description: The PHP version the code is checked against, e.g. `8.3`. Empty: from `composer.json` (`config.platform.php`, else the lowest version `require.php` allows), else the latest.

includePaths.description: Folders and single files outside the project whose code is indexed too: absolute, `~/…`, or relative to the project (`../shared`, `../../config.php`). A folder is indexed whole, so name the file when one file is all you need. A `composer.json` at the top of such a folder is read for what it autoloads, and so is the one beside a Composer `vendor` folder. Read only in a workspace you trust.

stubs.description: Extra phpstorm-stubs sets (`redis`, `swoole`, `mongodb`…) on top of the defaults and the `ext-*` requirements of `composer.json`.

exclude.description: Globs of files and folders left out of the index (`node_modules`, `/storage`). `null`: `node_modules`, `.git`, `storage/framework` and `bootstrap/cache`. `vendor` is read through Composer's `installed.json` either way.

inspections.description: Per-inspection settings by id, e.g. `{ "PhpUndefinedMethod": { "enabled": false } }`. The key `*` with `enabled: false` turns every inspection off.

detection.description: Laravel support: `auto` when `composer.json` requires `laravel/framework`, the lock file lists it, or `artisan` exists.

routeHints.description: Code lenses on controller methods listing their routes, and the full URI after each route registration.

modules.description: Which modules of a modular application are read: `nwidart/laravel-modules`, module folders (`modules/`, `app-modules/`…), both (`auto`), or none.

inertiaPages.description: Folders of Inertia pages, relative to the project. Empty: the `ide.json` page paths, else `resources/js/Pages`.

namespace.description: The application's root namespace for generated classes. Empty: the one `composer.json` maps to `app/`.

module.description: The module generated classes go to. Empty: the application.

controllerSuffix.description: The suffix of generated controller classes.

requestSuffix.description: The suffix of generated request classes.

resourceSuffix.description: The suffix of generated resource classes.

policySuffix.description: The suffix of generated policy classes.

seederSuffix.description: The suffix of generated seeder classes.

constructorPromotion.description: Generated constructors promote their parameters to properties.

typeHints.description: Generated methods declare their return types.

frameworks.description: Whether each framework's support is on: `auto` (when Composer installs the framework or one of its own files exists), `enabled` or `disabled`. `laravel` wins over `laravel.detection` unless it is `auto`. Laravel, Symfony, WordPress, Drupal, CodeIgniter, Yii and CakePHP have support today; the other names (`cakephp`, `laminas`, `magento`) are read now and take effect as each framework's support is released.

lineWidth.description: The line length Format Document tries to stay within.

tool.description: What formats a whole PHP file: `phoxite` (the built-in formatter) or `pint` (the project's Laravel Pint). A selection, and Blade files, are always formatted by Phoxite.

twig.description: What formats a whole Twig template: `phoxite` (the built-in formatter: indentation and the spacing inside tags) or `prettier` (the project's Prettier with a Twig plugin, which also rewraps lines and formats the JavaScript and CSS inside). A selection is always formatted by Phoxite.

arrayShapes.description: How an array shape reads in a type inlay hint: `compact` (`array`, once in a union of shapes) or `full` (with its keys and their types, `array{id: int, name: string}`). The hint's tooltip and hover show the full type either way.

path.description: The folder of the edited generator templates, relative to the project. Empty: `.phoxite/templates`.

strict.description: The type and call checks: report what they can't prove too.
